entities.name: Developer
entities.rationale: Icon of group of people labeled DEVELOPER at bottom-left (icon ~611,490). Left side of the dashed vertical divider. Pushes code to Git.

entities.name: Git
entities.rationale: Cylinder icon labeled GIT (icon 9 at 622,277). External source code repository, left of the dashed divider; receives arrow from Developer and points to Lagoon EKS.

entities.name: Lagoon EKS
entities.rationale: Orange EKS icon labeled EKS with the title LAGOON above it (icon 10 at 774,274). Left of the dashed vertical divider; the Lagoon control/build cluster that deploys to the right-hand side.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Orange EKS icon labeled EKS at top-right (icon 11 at 1149,187). Right of the dashed vertical divider; target workload cluster, top of a hierarchy fanning out to EC2 and EC2 Spot.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: EC2 instances icon labeled EC2 (icon 7 at 1059,373), below the right-hand EKS; on-demand worker nodes of the cluster. Points to Aurora R6G.

entities.name: EC2 Spot
entities.rationale: EC2 Spot icon labeled EC2 SPOT (icon 8 at 1233,371), below the right-hand EKS; spot worker nodes of the cluster. Points to EBS GP3 and EFS.

entities.name: Aurora R6G
entities.rationale: Blue Aurora icon labeled AURORA R6G (icon 4 at 988,555), bottom row on right side; database (Graviton R6G instances) under EC2.

entities.name: EBS GP3
entities.rationale: Green EBS icon labeled EBS GP3 (icon 3 at 1140,557), bottom row on right side; block storage under EC2 Spot.

entities.name: EFS
entities.rationale: Green EFS icon labeled EFS (icon 2 at 1298,558), bottom row on right side; shared file storage under EC2 Spot.
